svg.title: Full iDrone schematic with MacBook input and HS210 drone output
svg.desc: Top to bottom: MacBook sends hand-tracking data over USB to a Raspberry Pi Pico W. Pico sends power and I2C to an MCP4728 DAC. DAC's four analog outputs plus a shared ground run to five pads on the modified HS210 controller PCB. The controller transmits wirelessly over 2.4 GHz RF to the HS210 drone at the bottom.
svg.text: modified · R2 and R4 wipers cut
